purpose: Four-frame identity-preserving game animation; original bases and pet atlases unchanged.

prompts.arisu:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent pixel-art game animation sprite sheet, genuine four-frame animations. Edit the approved Arisu reference art into a new 4-column by 4-row equal-cell animation atlas (16 separate sprites). References: image 1 approved upper-body actions, image 2 approved identity. Keep adult Arisu's enormous blonde TWO curly ponytails with black roots and PINK tips, tan skin, pale olive eyes, thick black/white gyaru eye makeup, pink earrings, asymmetric black / hot-pink white-star jacket, black mesh top. Keep front-facing waist-up crop, large head, crisp dark pixel outlines and pixel shading. Every sprite has identical torso baseline, head size, 4% clear margin, exact evenly spaced cells. True transparent background, no floor, labels, frame numbers, grid lines or text. Each row is ONE action shown in four DISTINCT successive animation keyframes left-to-right; NOT four copies with whole-body bob. Hands, arms, head, eyes, and props visibly change.
ROW 1 driving: frame 1 both hands steering at 9 and 3, wheel pink stripe centered; frame 2 turn wheel LEFT 25 degrees hands following, glance left and head tilt left; frame 3 straighten wheel and blink; frame 4 turn wheel RIGHT 25 degrees hands following, glance right with head slight right. Torso planted.
ROW 2 point: frame 1 left hand steering and right forearm bent preparing; frame 2 right arm extends pointing diagonally up-right and talking mouth; frame 3 fully extended finger right, excited open mouth and head looking right; frame 4 retract right forearm halfway, smiling.
ROW 3 shocked: frame 1 both hands steering and eyebrows rising; frame 2 eyes very wide O-mouth shoulders up hands tighten on turned wheel; frame 3 head recoils slightly hands high on wheel mouth open; frame 4 exhales with eyes briefly closed wheel centered.
ROW 4 rally: pink racing goggles with transparent lenses, modest mud spots; frame 1 both hands steering centered; frame 2 wheel hard left hands follow head leans right; frame 3 centered wheel delighted open mouth; frame 4 wheel hard right hands follow head leans left.
Make all 16 poses large enough to read at small game scale. Preserve actual identity and clothing across all cells. 4 by 4 atlas with four equal columns and four equal rows.
prompts.chana:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent pixel-art game animation sprite sheet with four-frame sequences. Edit approved Chana reference art into a NEW 4-column by 4-row equal-cell animation atlas (16 sprites). References: image 1 approved upper-body actions, image 2 approved base identity. Keep adult Chana's voluminous blonde swept-up hair with black/brown roots and streaks and small front twist-braid, tan skin, olive eyes, gyaru eyeliner pink eye shadow, gold necklace, hot-pink jacket with yellow leopard motifs and black crop top. NO pink hair and NO twin ponytails. Preserve distinctive face and exact style of approved art. Every sprite front-facing waist-up crop, large head, same scale and torso baseline with 4% clear margin. True transparent background. Crisp dark-outlined pixels. No labels, frame numbers, grid lines, floor, text or extra people. Each row ONE action, four DISTINCT chronological keyframes left-to-right, so arms and props visibly animate independently of torso.
ROW 1 paper-map: frame 1 holds narrow folded cream road-map booklet chest high in two hands and looks down; frame 2 pulls hands apart to HALF unfold map, eyes following map; frame 3 holds WIDE unfolded cream paper road map with blue river, red roads and green areas across torso, eyes scanning left; frame 4 turns head slightly right, raises right edge and lowers left edge of open map, eyes scanning right. Obvious unfolding sequence.
ROW 2 directions: frame 1 folded map in left hand, right elbow bent right hand by chest preparing to point, mouth closed; frame 2 arm lifting diagonally right, speaking mouth; frame 3 arm fully extended right with pointing finger, head turns right, large open mouth; frame 4 right arm bends again while right finger points upward, smiling.
ROW 3 makeup: frame 1 small round PINK compact mirror OPEN in left hand held to side, right hand pink lipstick LOW at chest, eyes glance at mirror; frame 2 right hand RAISES lipstick halfway toward lips; frame 3 lipstick touches puckered lips, eyes focus mirror, visible bent wrist; frame 4 lipstick moves across lower lip and compact rotates slightly toward face, tiny wink. Hand and lipstick must visibly move between four frames.
ROW 4 cheer: frame 1 both fists shoulder height smile; frame 2 one fist overhead and other shoulder-height, eyes excited; frame 3 BOTH fists overhead mouth laughing eyes closed; frame 4 opposite fist overhead, other lowers to shoulder, open happy eyes.
All 16 sprites must be clearly distinct coherent action animation frames. Exact evenly spaced 4 by 4 atlas, no clipped hair or hands.
